question: Which beings are named in this ascending series?
premises: Murti, one-eye, and one-rudra are named.
Highest Shiva, subtle Rudra, Ananta, and eight Vidyeshvaras are named.
inference: The verse lists beings in the ascending aisha series.
plain_english: Shikhanda, Shrigala, Murti, one-eye, one-rudra, highest Shiva, subtle Rudra, Ananta, and the eight Vidyeshvaras are named.
